params.name: assetPath
params.description: The path to a specific asset. This is a generic string in the format of the implementing service. Some examples include IDs such as `123` or `abc` and full paths such as `/some/path/to/asset.jpeg`.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: When true, a thumbnail of the asset should be returned. See the expanded parameter descriptionbelow.

items.docs: Retrieve an asset specified by its assetPath
